name: Tryndamere
title: the Barbarian King

Q.name: Bloodlust
Q.description: Passive: Tryndamere thirsts for blood, gaining up to 20/35/50/65/80 Attack Damage based on his missing Health. Active: Tryndamere consumes his Fury, restoring 30/40/50/60/70 + 0.3×AP plus 0.5/0.95/1.4/1.85/2.3 + 0.012×AP Health per Fury (max: 30/40/50/60/70 + 0.3×AP + (? × (0.5/0.95/1.4/1.85/2.3 + 0.012×AP))).
Q.summary: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.

W.name: Mocking Shout
W.description: Tryndamere hurls insults, reducing champions' Attack Damage by 20/35/50/65/80 for 4 seconds and Slowing by 30/35/40/45/50% while cowering from him for 3.25 seconds.
W.summary: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.

E.name: Spinning Slash
E.description: Tryndamere spins through his enemies, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 + 1×bonus AD + 0.8×AP physical damage and generating 2 Fury per enemy hit, increased to 5 Fury against enemy champions. This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds when Tryndamere critically strikes, and reduced by 1.5 seconds when critically striking a champion.
E.summary: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.

R.name: Undying Rage
R.description: Tryndamere becomes completely immune to death for 5 seconds, refusing to be reduced below 30/50/70 Health, and instantly gains 50/75/100 Fury.
R.summary: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.

Passive.name: Battle Fury
Passive.description: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.
Passive.summary: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Split-pushing melee carry who builds Fury for crits and survives all-ins with Undying Rage. Bullies early with Q heals and wins side-lane duels.
strengths: Strong level 1–3 dueling and sustain via Q heal
R stops him from dying for a few seconds
E dash with cooldown cut by crits: hard to escape from
W slows and reduces enemy AD
weaknesses: Kited hard by ranged champions and crowd control
Armor stacking and Grievous Wounds hurt him
R window can be waited out
profile.curveNote: Strong from level 1 thanks to Fury and Q sustain.
profile.sustain: high – Q converts Fury to health

Q.notes: Heals based on Fury; passive bonus AD from missing health.

W.notes: Reduces enemy attack damage; slows those facing away.

E.notes: Dash through enemies; cooldown lowered by crits.

R.notes: Can't drop below a health floor for 5 s: don't burn your execute into it.

profile.windowAgainst: R on cooldown: real kill window. Kite him when E is down.
